intents_zh: 便宜 vs 強模型路由
intents_en: route to small or big llm
code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

def classify_difficulty(q: str) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{small_model}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user",
                   "content": f"Reply HARD or EASY only:\n{q}"}],
    )
    return "hard" if "HARD" in r.choices[0].message.content.upper() else "easy"

def route(q: str) -> str:
    model = "{{big_model}}" if classify_difficulty(q) == "hard" else "{{small_model}}"
    r = client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": q}])
    return r.choices[0].message.content
summary_zh: 小模型先判難度再路由大模型
